Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

fastDiversity (development version)

Changes to statistics

  • Documentation now explains how monomorphic sites affect each statistic, including that pi and theta from pi_theta_d_stats() are sums over segregating sites rather than per-site values.
  • faststats(): the previous Fst column, (Ht - Hs) / Ht, was mislabelled as Weir & Cockerham (1984). It is now named Gst (Nei 1973). A new Fst column gives population-specific FST (Weir & Goudet 2017) for each site, relative to the other retained sites in the genetic group.
  • New calculate_Fst(): population-specific FST (Weir & Goudet 2017); matches hierfstat::fs.dosage().
  • faststats(): Ar is now rarefied allelic richness, as documented, using calculate_rarified_Ar() across the retained sites in each genetic group. Previously it was the mean number of alleles per individual (1 + Ho).
  • calculate_Ar(): now returns the (unrarefied) mean number of alleles observed per locus. Previously it returned 1 + Ho.
  • calculate_rarified_Ar(): uses log-scale binomial coefficients (previously overflowed to 0 for large samples), returns NA for loci not genotyped at every site, returns site and locus names, and handles single-individual sites; matches hierfstat::allelic.richness() on complete data.

Bug fixes

  • make_allele_list() / matcher(): alleles were assigned using DArT 1-row coding (2 = heterozygote) instead of the package’s 0=aa, 1=aA, 2=AA coding. Private and total allele counts from calculate_private_alleles() change as a result, and now agree with calculate_total_alleles().
  • faststats(): statistic columns are now numeric (previously character).
  • faststats(): return_locus_stats = TRUE no longer errors when run_HWE_test = FALSE; it now runs the HWE test automatically.
  • resampling_loci_CI(), resampling_individuals_CI(): no longer call set.seed(14) internally, which overwrote the user’s random number state. Use set.seed() before calling them for reproducible intervals.
  • MC_HWEtest_of_loci(): matrix input now works (previously only data frames), and the per-locus “genotypes are not labelled” warnings are gone.
  • individual_Ho(): no longer errors when a group has too few loci.
  • faststats(): statistics are calculated at full precision and rounded only in the output (per-locus He was previously rounded before averaging).
  • faststats(): groups where no loci pass the missingness filter are skipped with a message instead of erroring.
  • faststats(): bootstrap CIs no longer error when all resampled values are NA.
  • pi_theta_d_stats(): minimum_loci is now applied (it was ignored), statistic columns are numeric, and sites with a single remaining locus or no segregating sites no longer error.

Other changes

  • C++ helpers are compiled with the package instead of at runtime with Rcpp::cppFunction(), so bootstrapping is much faster and no compiler is needed after installation.
  • Progress output uses message() instead of print()/cat(), so it can be silenced with suppressMessages().
  • Unused future.apply dependency removed.
  • Example dataset documented (?example_data).
  • Expanded test suite with checks against hand-calculated values.
  • pkgdown documentation site and R CMD check GitHub Action added.

fastDiversity 1.3.0

Changes to existing functions

  • calculate_pi_theta_d(): reimplemented with a vectorised approach for improved performance. Non-segregating and monomorphic sites are now removed prior to calculation. The function now accepts the same gt matrix format used throughout the package. Return value structure has changed: the function now returns tajima_d, num_sites, raw_pi, watterson_theta, and d_stdev (previously returned pi, S, theta, D, and per_site_stats).
